caseNameFull: Ripperger, Receiver v. A. C. Allyn & Co., Inc.
attorneys: Messrs. Jacob K. Javits and Perdval E. Jackson for petitioner. Mr. Claire W. Hardy for A. C. Allyn & Co., and Mr. John C. Bruton, Jr. for the First Boston Corporation, respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
